nykra_ko.fixes: Reads as a mid-air tumble, not lying down: body tilted about 45 degrees, legs kicking up, and the belly and tail are well above the shadow. Rotate to about 80-90 degrees so the flank lies flat (spine toward camera or ground), y-squash less, then translate down so the lowest body edge sits on the shadow centre line. Fade the ragged mane and tail edge halos.

abyssor_ko.fixes: Optional: scale up about 15 percent to match the other heroes' footprint. Reads as a curled, slumped dead cephalopod resting on its shadow, no cropping, clean edges, design faithful, darkened and desaturated.

umbrel_ko.fixes: Still floats: the foot is about 40 px above the shadow and the cap is high. It looks like a tilted standing figure, not a KO. Two see-through holes in the stem/arm at the left, ragged cutout fringes and edge halos. Fix the source cutout first: fill the holes (inpaint or alpha-close then fill from neighbouring bark), erode 1-2 px to kill the halo, then rotate to about 75-90 degrees so the cap rests on the ground. Translate down so the lowest pixel touches the shadow, and shrink the shadow to the footprint. Re-submit.
